text.p: Millennium Pharmaceuticals Inc and ChemGenics Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Monday Millenium will acquire ChemGenics for 4.8 million shares of its stock.
Also, PerSeptive Biosystems Inc, a principal shareholder of ChemGenics, will get $4.0 million in a settlment of a promissory note and the purchase of warrants, Millenium and ChemGenics said.

Millennium and ChemGenics said ChemGenics shareholders have agreed to a lock-up arrangement with regard to the Millennium shares to be received in the merger, which expires in installments through September 30, 1997.
PerSeptive said in a separate statement that it will get about 1.6 million shares of Millennium common stock.
ChemGenics and Millennium said the deal will broaden their alliances and product pipeline.

ChemGenics brings screening capabilities that will allow Millennium to progress with the development of small molecule drug leads in all of the areas where the company has retained rights, the companies said.
ChemGenics has a proprietary natural products drug source and access to compound libraries through corporate alliances, the companies said.

These complement the combinatorial and pharmaceutical compound libraries that Millennium has accessed through its collaborations with Eli Lilly and Co and the Wyeth-Ayerst unit of American Home Products Corp, the companies said.
Millennium presently employs 275 people and the combined companies will employ over 345 people, the companies said. A Millennium spokeswoman said no layoffs are planned.
